text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Traceeen! Academyyy! Cheer Squad!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We, the Tracen Cheer Squad, have formed
for the upcoming Spring
Fan Fest!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Our sworn duty: to cheer on the
Umamusume who will run in the

competition and boost everyone's morale!

text_block_list.name: Cheer Squad
text_block_list.text: Osu!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: And to that end...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
We will be sporting a new,
high-performance costume! It supports

abdominal breathing! It even has a built-in
microphone!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Wh-whaaaaa?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Great surprise, isn't it? I'm glad I
kept it secret until the big
reveal!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I wish you hadn't, then at least I could've
stopped you! And please,
what have you
got Pearl doing?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Much like fireworks or a disco ball, things
that sparkle lift people's
spirits! Besides,
isn't it glorious? It's like this costume was
made for
Pearl.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Gooo fooor iiit. ♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I have no idea what's going on anymore...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
WHY YOUUU! KING HALOOO! Was it you
who messed with the
school speaker
settings?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
A complaint came in to the disciplinary
committee. The speakers
suddenly
stopped working, then some weird
singing... wait, what's
going on here?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Agh! I didn't think the disciplinary
committee would sniff us out this
fast!
Cheer Squad! Time out! Retreeeat!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... What have I gotten myself into?
This is way too chaotic...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So, basically... Tracen Cheer Squad is a
temporary team formed in the
lead-up to
the Spring Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Fan Fests are held twice a year, one in
spring and one in fall. The
Spring Fan Fest
is a sports day, while the Fall Fan Fest is a
cultural
day.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In the Spring Fan Fest, students from all
over the academy gather to
take part in
contests and events to entertain their fans.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Every year, a Cheer Squad is formed to
liven up the event, and this
time it's King
who's in charge. Joining her are Pearl and
I, along with
the rest of the squad.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right, Pearl?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Nice one, Nature. You
summed everything up perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Then can you do me a favor and try not to make things crazier than they already are? You know King will go overboard if you give her the chance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh? But why? I don't think her ideas are
bad at all. Her way of
thinking is—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: BOOM, CHA CHA! CHIKI CHIKI CHA! BOOM TA TA! CHA CHA!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ngh?! Where's all this rowdy music coming
from? I hope this isn't what
I think it is...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...you think? On the... drums... whistles...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Aghhh...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what's going on here?! Who's
responsible for this racket?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Later this week, we'll be performing a
special practice session for
visitors from
outside the academy, so I get why she's
pulling out all
the stops, but still...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The weird costume, the live music... She
even made giant party
crackers... Ahhh,
why is she making everything so flashy?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if I asked her what she was thinking, I
don't think she'd give me
a straight
answer.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I hear you'd like some answers?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! Pearl?! You almost gave me a
heart attack...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I heard the voice of a lost child and
my body moved before I
could even think
about it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, about King. It all started one
month ago, as far as I know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It was the day that sign-ups started for the
Fan Fest competitions.
That's when King...
